title: The Linguistic Barrier
description: Distance-based chat + learnable dialects for immersive roleplay.
body:
# The Linguistic Barrier

Make chat **immersive**: communication is restricted by **distance** and by the **dialects** players have learned.

## How it works

- **Closer = clearer**. Far away messages degrade into enchanting-table glyphs (Galactic alphabet vibe).
- Want to trade? Meet **face to face** instead of spying on global chat.

## Dialects

Players can learn rare dialects by finding **Dialect Tomes**:

- **Nether Speak**: understand / communicate with players in the Nether
- **Enderman Echo**: understand / communicate with players in The End

Cross-dimension communication works when **both players** know the dialect.

## Commands

- `/lingbarrier dialects` (shows what you know)
- `/lingbarrier reload` (admin)
- `/lingbarrier givebook <dialect> [player]` (admin)

## Config

Everything is configurable:

- Clear / max chat distance
- Dialect books (name/lore) + drop chances + mob sources
